name: FMA IA-58 Pucará (Pastrana)
summary: Free flyable FMA IA-58 Pucará twin-turboprop attack aircraft mod for DCS World (v0.12b, 2021).
description: Flyable IA-58 Pucará by Pastrana with SFM, TACAN/ILS displays, two radios (SRS), damage visuals and liveries; README says it needs no other modules. Free build v0.12b dates from Aug 2021 (DCS 2.7 era). The newer v1.0 EFM (Oct 2026) is a Patreon subscription release, not free.

releases.changelog: Engine start fix, rain canopy, TACAN/ILS/VOR displays, two radios, damage visuals, wing tanks, LODs, tutorial PDF.
